To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) smartphone sensor data contains information that can be used to identify individual users with a high degree and accuracy, (2) accelerometer and gyroscopic data collected from smartphone users can be used to predict their height and weight with a moderate degree of accuracy, and (3) the accuracy of predicting a user's gender from smartphone sensor data is high.

(i) we can predict a user's weight and height with 57% accuracy, (ii) we can predict whether a user is male or female with 83% accuracy, (iii) we can predict the identity of a smartphone owner with a 96% accuracy and (iv) we can predict if a smartphone is being carried in a user's pants pocket with 95% accuracy.
